info.name: IMC Project Management - Demo (DRD)
info.description:
Sample requests/responses modul IMC Project Management berdasarkan DRD_IMC_Project_Management.docx (flexible project + stage workflow).

Semua endpoint dilindungi JWT (Authorization: Bearer). Folder Master Data & Custom Field khusus admin.

Base URL sementara (DRD Gap #12: modul diusulkan menjadi project-service):
http://localhost:4076/project-service/api

Alur demo (13 langkah DRD):
2. Daftar/Buat Proyek -> 3. Wizard (pilih workflow, timeline, review, activate) -> 4-7. Stage/Task/Dokumen/Deliverable -> 8. Approval -> 9. Change Request -> 10. Milestone -> 11. Activity Log

Contoh data: proyek IMC.2026-001 'Development Mesin A' (PT ABC, ETO Manufacturing v1, 8 stage).

request.description: KPI dashboard (DRD Bab 2.6): total proyek, proyek aktif, milestone, approval menunggu + kartu proyek.

response.name: 200 - Daftar proyek

request.description: Buat Proyek simple form (DRD langkah 3). Status awal draft. title/name salah satu wajib; slug & project_no otomatis. Set is_publicated=true agar tampil di public-content-service.

request.description: Hanya untuk proyek status draft (belum aktif).

item.name: 3. Project Wizard & Lifecycle

request.description: DRD langkah 4: pilih workflow template ATAU mode manual (mode='manual' + array stages).

response.name: 200 - Stage di-instansiasi dari workflow

request.description: DRD langkah 5: tanggal mulai/selesai per stage + dependency. Catatan: kolom dependency merupakan rekomendasi Gap #3 DRD.
DRD langkah 7 (Review & Activate): simpan draft / kirim untuk approval.

item.description: Alur 13 langkah bagian setup & lifecycle (DRD langkah 4–7).

request.description: DRD langkah 10 / Bab 3.6: progress manual atau turunan dari task.
Menyelesaikan stage; mengharuskan deliverable wajib lunas + approval gate.

response.name: 200 - Daftar task

body.raw:
{
    "title": "Assembly komponen mesin",
    "description": "Rakit frame + motor sesuai drawing v2",
    "priority": "high",

response.name: 200 - Daftar dokumen

request.description: Multipart upload; integrasi file-service (file_path pointer). Validasi ekstensi & ukuran dari DOCUMENT_TYPE. Setiap unggahan = versi +1.

response.name: 201 - Dokumen diunggah (versi 2)
200 - Daftar deliverable

request.description: Menandai deliverable selesai; menunggu dokumen dengan document_type yang sama.

response.name: 200 - Deliverable disubmit

request.description: Antrean approval (DRD langkah 13). Gap #9: approval_type membedakan aktivasi/gate/CR/deliverable.

response.name: 200 - Antrean approval

request.description: approve / reject + notes; mencatat approved_by & approved_at.

response.name: 200 - Keputusan disimpan
200 - Daftar CR

request.description: CR berisi alasan + dampak + approval + audit trail (prinsip #7).

response.name: 201 - CR diajukan

request.description: Menandai CR sudah dieksekusi di stage (status implemented).

response.name: 200 - Aktivitas proyek

request.description: code digenerate sistem (cf_{entity_type}_{id}). field_type enum: text, textarea, number, money, date, datetime, boolean, select, multiselect, email, url, file.
